title: Moroccan Beef Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Moroccan stew made with tender beef and aromatic spices. Serve with crusty bread or couscous.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.amount: 1 lb (450g) beef short ribs or chuck

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Transfer the stew to the oven and cook, covered, at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the almonds and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or with crusty bread.
